accountName: The A Firm Financial Solutions Group
summary: The A Firm is a small Gold Coast (Varsity Lakes) chartered accounting and advisory practice led by CEO Annette Bedford, who has 30 years in accounting and founded the First Class Accounts bookkeeping franchise. Its services include bookkeeping with bank reconciliations and monthly reporting, Xero training and CFO solutions. Annette offers a free 15-minute meet and greet to new clients.
